semantics.identity_rule: Identity, group, membership, role, right and authorization-decision identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: add/remove-member/assign-role/revoke-role operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing membership grants no membership-management authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Effective paths correspond only to explicit membership/binding refs.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

hard_gates.condition: effective rights inferred from visual nesting
